title: SoFi Launches Interest-Bearing Tokenized Deposit for Consumers
why_it_matters: The launch brings a tokenized bank deposit to retail users and separates the interest-bearing, FDIC-eligible deposit liability from the stablecoin used to move funds on blockchain rails.
caption:
RWA WIRE // TOKENIZED DEPOSITS

SoFi Launches Interest-Bearing Tokenized Deposit for Consumers

SoFi Earn represents deposits at SoFi Bank, offers a variable 4.40% APY as of October 20, and converts one-for-one into SoFiUSD for crypto purchases or supported wallet transfers.
